summary: Tested NEW AI Background Remover feature (images sync + videos async) on backend & frontend. 9/9 backend tests passed (image transparent/color/image modes, video transparent webm + color mp4 async flows, stats counters, SVGA regression). Frontend /remove-bg page renders correctly with all required testids; mode switching reveals proper inputs; Header has 'Remove BG' nav and Home page has removebg-cta which navigates correctly. End-to-end UI flow (upload PNG -> click Remove background -> image-result rendered + toast 'Background removed') verified live against the production preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: bgremove.remove_image returns PNG for ALL modes including color/image (even though composited result is opaque). Document or change ext to jpg/webp for opaque outputs to reduce payload (minor).

BG_JOBS_DIR=/tmp/bgjobs is ephemeral; after pod restart status='done' rows in mongo point to missing files and /result will throw FileNotFoundError (500). Consider cleanup on startup or storing in persistent storage.
_run_bg_video runs blocking rembg+ffmpeg in default executor — concurrent submissions can saturate the worker thread pool. Consider a bounded queue or semaphore.
bg_video_result reads entire file into memory; for larger outputs, prefer FileResponse for streaming.
data-testid in Header is 'nav-remove bg' (with space) — works but slightly unconventional; consider 'nav-remove-bg'.
seed_data_creation: Generated /tmp/sample.svga (200x200 24f 24fps) via svga_codec.encode for SVGA regression. Generated tiny 2s 160x120 mp4 in pytest tmp dir via imageio_ffmpeg color source for video tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend bg tests in /app/backend/tests/test_bgremove.py (separate from backend_test.py). Video tests take ~60-90s each (rembg+ffmpeg). Use pytest-xdist (already configured in pytest.ini) to parallelize. /tmp can be cleared between sessions — regression test now re-creates sample.svga inline. rembg u2net model lives at ~/.u2net/u2net.onnx.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found in the new feature. Initial UI E2E attempt failed with 400 because the test fixture base64 PNG was malformed; replaced with a valid PIL-generated PNG and E2E succeeded.
